signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Passers with this ability are immune to throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while on the run
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws inside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Receivers with this ability have a high success rate when creating separation on the last cut of any route.
When in the red zone, receivers with this ability have a better chance to win contested catches against single coverage.
When lined up at wide receiver (excluding slot), players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Players with this ability are more likely to succeed at and attempt diving catches and swats.
Blockers with this ability gain blocker resistance points as a faster rate
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Run Stuffers can singlehandedly disrupt an offense. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one run blocks.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
Defenders with this ability can make jumping, 180-degree interceptions while lurking in a zone in the middle of the field.
Defenders with this ability will cause increased fatigue penalties when tackling a ballcarrier with a non-conservative tackle.
